scope: One deterministic author fixture; no provider/API/budget retry or existing Vault takeover

units.label: source/contract
independent_checks: four required atoms and complete qualifiers
two canonical placements and independent expected

units.label: stage verification
independent_checks: staged bytes exactly match prior authored literals
all atoms retain unit/condition/exception in the declared scope
no extra hidden/unregistered content or output files

units.label: vault/readback
independent_checks: staging and Vault readback bytes equal
stable note IDs and two unique headings resolve
both real local links resolve to intended notes

units.label: publication
independent_checks: one confirmed publication commit for the logical release
no duplicate stable entities or publication on resume
interrupted or unverified state never reports published

allowed_paths: Only the selected copied fixture and a new explicitly owned test output root

version_rules.changed_source_or_contract: Invalidate source_contract and its descendants or explicitly refuse incompatible resume; never silently reuse them.
version_rules.changed_renderer_or_plan_policy: Source evidence may remain verified if its pins match; invalidate render and its descendants.
version_rules.changed_verification_or_publication_poli: Invalidate the affected unit and descendants; old confirmations remain as history.
version_rules.unknown_version_or_untrusted_checkpoint: Refuse and preserve the owned observed state; no silent adoption or migration.

pause_rule.inflight_and_safe_flush: May continue to the safe boundary, with explicit observed status.

audit: The unit labels are frozen author semantics, not a claim that a new Run API already exists.
